walkthroughs.body_html:
12% increase → multiplier 1.12.

15% decrease → multiplier 0.85. £400 with 12% rise: 400 × 1.12 = £448.

£500 at 4% per year for 3 years.

Total = 500 × 1.04³ = 500 × 1.124864 ≈ £562.43.

Bottle A: 2 L for £3. Bottle B: 3 L for £4.20.

A: £1.50 per L. B: £1.40 per L. B is the best buy.
